title: Consistency My Beloved
description: Changes textures of various modded materials to make them consistent. Works best with Almost Unified.
body:
This resource pack will receive updates.
Some items may not have resprites. This is because the Almost Unified mod is used to remov duplicates. See the priority order below.
This was made for 1.18.2, but should work with any version. Please report any problems.

Set up your Almost Unified priorities this way to make the resource pack fully work:
"Minecraft",  
"immersiveengineering",    
"immersivepetroleum",  
"immersiveposts",  
"mekanism",  
"thermal",    
"industrialforegoing",  
"pneumaticcraft",   
"create",  
"createdeco",  
"createbigcannons"  

Currently supported mods:  
- Blue Skies Tinkers Compat  
- Create  
- Create Crafts & Additions  
- Immersive Engineering  
- PneumaticCraft: Repressurized  
- Tinkers' Construct  
- Thermal Series  

Changes:  
- Blue Skies Tinkers Compat plate casts get Immersive Engineering plate shapes  
- Create Crushed Raw ore palettes got fixed  
- Create Crafts & Additions gets Immersive Engineering rod and wires textures  
- Immersive Engineering ingot proportions & Metal Press Molds are now fixed  
- Mekanism gets Thermal's Bronze and Tin palettes  
- PneumaticCraft gear gets Thermal gear texture  
- Tinkers' Construct plate casts get Immersive Engineering plate shapes  
- Thermal plates get Immersive Engineering plate textures  

Planned support & changes (by priority):  
- Mekanism & Thermal dusts and blends to Immersive Engineering grit textures   
- Create ingots' proportions fix and sheets would get Immersive Engineering plate textures    
- Allomancy
